# CameraShotParams (push)

Configured camera recording parameters from GetPushShotParams, not the Lightbridge preview format. Raw enums are retained; absent extensions are null. Callers must validate sender/index and packet direction.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** Classic DJI GO 3.1.8 DataCameraGetPushShotParams getVideoFormat (13), getVideoFps (14), getVideoStoreFormat (19), getVideoStandard (55), getPrimaryVideoEncodeType (69 low nibble) and getSecondaryVideoEncodeType (69 high nibble). Three identical 72-byte captured payloads. Enum interpretation and model limits: docs/camera-video-push.md. Only one setting captured so far.
